appName: Car Dealership Simulator Buy & Sell Cars
displayName: Car Dealership Simulator Buy & Sell Cars
display_name: Car Dealership Simulator Buy & Sell Cars
display_long_description:
Start with a small showroom and turn it into the most successful car dealership in town. Search for great deals, buy used cars, inspect their condition, repair damaged parts, clean and customize each vehicle, then display them in your showroom for customers to admire.
Every sale is an opportunity to grow your business. Negotiate with buyers, set the right prices, and maximize your profits. Upgrade your dealership, expand your showroom, unlock new vehicles, and improve your reputation as you become the ultimate car dealer.
Success depends on making smart business decisions. Find valuable cars, invest in repairs, and decide when to sell for the highest return. Every choice affects your dealership's growth.
Features
Buy used cars at the best prices.
Repair and restore vehicles to increase their value.
Clean and customize cars before putting them on display.
Manage your own car showroom and dealership.
Negotiate with customers and close profitable deals.
Earn money and expand your business.
Unlock new cars, upgrades, and dealership improvements.
Enjoy realistic dealership management and immersive gameplay in VR.
Whether you enjoy business simulation, tycoon games, or car trading, Car Dealership Simulator: Buy & Sell Cars lets you experience the thrill of building a successful automotive business from the ground up. Buy smart, repair expertly, negotiate confidently, and become the most successful car dealer in the city!
